name: Captain Marvel, Apex Avenger
oracle_text:
Flying, double strike, indestructible
Whenever you put one or more counters on another creature, if it's not a Kree, you may put the same number and kind of counters on Captain Marvel.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you put one or more counters on another creature, if it's not a Kree, you may put the same number and kind of counters on Captain Marvel.

needs.what: a counter_placed trigger that exposes the triggering placement's counter kind and amount to its effects, so an add_counters on the source can put 'the same number and kind of counters' (any kind, not one fixed kind) that were just put on the other creature
needs.why_existing_wont_do: counter_placed with put_by: you and a filter (types Creature, exclude_self, not_subtypes Kree) can detect the event, but its `counter` trigger key fixes ONE kind, and op_add_counters reads `counter` as a fixed string; no value_key reads the event's placed amount or kind, so the trigger cannot mirror an arbitrary kind and number
